metadata.title: Anteroom - the waiting room does the paperwork
metadata.audience: Ship-a-ton judges evaluating in under two minutes, plus clinicians.
metadata.intent: The viewer should leave knowing Anteroom extracts a real clinical brief and flags what it cannot read instead of guessing.

scene.intent: Name the pain before showing any product.

shot.visual: The two real source documents side by side: a GP referral letter and a repeat prescription whose Warfarin dose is blurred and blotted.
shot.text: A 10-minute appointment. A folder of paper.
shot.motion: Both pages drift in slowly; the blotted dose cell is the last thing to settle.
shot.voiceover: In Spain the appointment is ten minutes and the paperwork is a folder.

shot.visual: Same two pages; a red ring draws around the illegible Warfarin dose.
shot.motion: Ring draws on over 600ms, then holds.
shot.voiceover: Some of it is unreadable. Guessing is worse.

scene.intent: Cut to the product with one promise.

shot.visual: Anteroom dashboard on a real Android device, signed in.
shot.text: Anteroom turns the folder into one brief.
shot.motion: Hard cut from the paper. Phone settles into frame.
shot.voiceover: Anteroom turns that folder into one structured brief.

scene.intent: Show real capture, not a mock.

shot.visual: Screen recording: tap Snap paperwork, the capture screen opens, From gallery opens the Android photo picker.
shot.motion: Real-time screen recording, no speed change.
shot.voiceover: Photograph the paperwork, or pick it from the library.

shot.visual: Both pages selected, Done tapped, the captured strip fills with two real thumbnails and the header reads 2 pages captured.
shot.motion: Real-time. The thumbnail strip is the payoff of this shot.
shot.voiceover: They upload to your account, and you can see exactly what you captured.

scene.intent: Show the model doing its first, cheap job.

shot.visual: The review screen with the banner "Detected: Referral - tap a chip to change" and both page thumbnails rendered.
shot.motion: Hold on the detected banner, then the chips.
shot.voiceover: Gemini Flash types the document. You can override it in one tap.

scene.intent: The real model call. Split in two so the trim is visible, not hidden.

shot.visual: Generate brief tapped; the processing dialog runs, reading "This usually takes 5-10 seconds".
shot.voiceover: Gemini 2.5 Pro reads both pages, in the EU.

shot.visual: The finished brief appears. An on-screen label states that model time was trimmed.
shot.motion: Hard cut, with the trim labelled on screen rather than sped up silently.
shot.voiceover: Eighteen seconds later, the brief is there.

scene.intent: The payoff. The product refuses to guess.

shot.visual: Top of the brief: the red FLAGGED FOR CLINICAL REVIEW (1) banner reading "Warfarin dose unreadable on page 2".
shot.text: It flags what it cannot read
shot.motion: Hold. This is the frame the whole video exists for.
shot.voiceover: It found seven medications. And it refused to guess the eighth.

shot.visual: Scrolled to the medication list: every drug shows dose and frequency, Warfarin shows "as directed" and no dose line at all.
shot.text: No dose. Not a guessed dose.
shot.motion: Slow scroll stops on the Warfarin row.
shot.voiceover: Every other drug has its dose, verbatim. Warfarin has none.

shot.visual: Source documents strip, then the full-screen page inspector showing the original blotted prescription.
shot.text: Every line traces back to the page
shot.motion: Tap through to the inspector; hold on the smudged cell.
shot.voiceover: And the original page is one tap away, so any line can be checked.

shot.visual: Download PDF (watermarked) tapped; the Android share sheet appears with anteroom-brief-*.pdf.
shot.voiceover: Export a PDF for the clinic. On the free tier the server watermarks it.

shot.visual: The two real PDFs side by side: the watermarked English free export and the clean Spanish Pro export.
shot.motion: Free page fades to the Pro page; the watermark disappears and the labels turn Spanish.
shot.voiceover: Pro removes the watermark and renders it in Spanish.

scene.intent: RevenueCat, and why the gate is server-side.

shot.visual: The Anteroom Pro paywall on Android, showing the monthly and lifetime packages from the live offering.
shot.motion: Paywall slides up. Hold on the packages.
shot.voiceover: RevenueCat purchases-kmp - one implementation, two stores.

shot.visual: Terminal frame: the pipeline suite printing "translateBrief denied for free user :: PERMISSION_DENIED" and "Pro PDF is NOT watermarked :: False".
shot.text: The gate is on the server, not the client
shot.motion: Lines print in sequence; the two verdict lines highlight.
shot.voiceover: The server decides, not the client. It cannot unlock itself.

scene.intent: Close on the claim that is actually defensible.

shot.visual: Anteroom wordmark over the flagged brief, with the four target names and the repository URL.
shot.text: Anteroom - it tells you what it could not read
shot.motion: Wordmark settles; subtitle and URL fade up.
shot.voiceover: Anteroom. Android, iOS, desktop and web, from one Kotlin codebase.
